opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), up to £300 for Scheme (C).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility varies by scheme: (A) open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. (B) & (C) open to PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. Supervisors must be current members of The Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society or SIG meetings, non-Genetics Society meetings, and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as they are studying or working in the UK, or the course they wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year. Supervisors must also be a member of The Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Helps with grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. Must be based at a UK university. Both the student and the research group leader must be members of The Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports undergraduate students to gain experience in genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.

opportunities.title: Communicating Your Science Workshop

amount.raw: The Genetics Society will cover travel (within the UK only), accommodation and meals for successful applicants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to PhD student and postdoctoral researcher Society members working in genetics and related areas. Must be accompanied by a supporting letter from a supervisor who is also a member of The Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Brings together experts in different fields to help participants explore and develop their communication skills.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member can apply, regardless of age of person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £60/day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs.
